en.description:
Be the spark of hope for humanity’s future in a world that has fallen.

Developed by BIG FIRE GAMES, CINDER CITY is an MMO Tactical Shooter set in a dystopian world, unfolding against the backdrop of the megacity Seoul.

Experience a new kind of tactical shooting action in an open-world near-future setting, where the advanced technologies of the 23rd century merge with the tactics of the 21st century.

snippet.description:
CINDER CITY 공식 트레일러 최초 공개!
'gamescom Opening Night Live 2025'에서 공개된 CINDER CITY 트레일러를 통해 최초로 공개하는 멀티플레이 컨텐츠와 다양한 캐릭터들을 확인해보세요.
(본 트레일러는 실제 게임 장면 및 게임플레이로 구성되어 있습니다. 현재 개발 중인 게임으로 이후 일부 콘텐츠가 변경될 수 있습니다.)

CINDER CITY는 언리얼 엔진 5 기반의 사실적인 그래픽과 몰입도 높은 AAA급 내러티브를 기반으로, 전략적 협동이 중심이 되는 오픈월드 MMO 택티컬 슈터입니다.

en.title: [CINDER CITY] Official Reveal Trailer | 2025 gamescom
en.description:
CINDER CITY – Official Trailer World Premiere!
Through the CINDER CITY trailer revealed at gamescom Opening Night Live 2025, check out the multiplayer content and diverse characters being unveiled for the first time.
(This trailer is composed of actual in-game scenes and gameplay. As the game is still in development, some content may be subject to change.)

CINDER CITY features hyper-realistic graphics built on Unreal Engine 5, and delivers an immersive AAA narrative. It is an open-world MMO tactical shooter where strategic cooperation takes center stage.
